title: Firewall Rules
subtitle: Allow or block ports and addresses. A change you do not keep within the time shown is undone.
loadFailed: Unable to load the firewall rules.
addFailed: The rule could not be added.
removeFailed: The rule could not be removed.
confirmFailed: The change could not be kept.
undone: The change was not kept in time, so it has been undone.
formHelp: Give a port, a source address, or both. A block is checked before every allow.
empty: No rules added from dPanel yet.
onlyOurs: Only rules in the shapes dPanel writes are listed. Rules written by hand on the server are left alone.
pendingHelp: Click Keep within {seconds} seconds, or the firewall goes back to how it was. If this page stops answering, the change locked you out and will be undone.
wafBansEmpty: No address is banned right now.
wafBansLoadFailed: Unable to load the WAF bans.
wafLiftConfirm: Lift the ban on {ip}? Its earlier bans are forgotten too.
wafLiftFailed: The ban could not be lifted.
wafBansHelp: An address the WAF blocks 10 times in 10 minutes is banned for an hour. Banned again within 30 days, it gets a day, then a week. Bans end on their own.
